title: Strategy decomposition
description: One record per (case_id, trial). Produced by group_into_strategies.py. Lives at {cache_root}/{model}/strategies.jsonl (group output) and strategies_post_review.jsonl (after review apply-overrides).

summary.description: 5-15 word LLM headline summarizing the connected component.

id.description: Sub-action id; mirrors the match actions[].id of the underlying action.

matched.description: True if any sub_action matched at least one rubric option.

partial_option_ids.description: Singleton option IDs flagged partial by the match step; propagated for the adapter.

_overrides_applied.description: (strategies_post_review only) Count of review overrides realized at the strategy / sub_action level.

_promotions_unattributed.description: (strategies_post_review only) Count of promotions where the reviewer emitted action_id=null (explicit coverage-gap signal). The option flag flips downstream in the adapter for recall accounting; the strategies graph stays unchanged.
